name: boldvoice-pronunciation
description: Rehearse the English you need for an interview, presentation or next meeting—with BoldVoice inside ChatGPT. Read your own English text aloud (up to 60 words and 400 characters), see word-by-word pronunciation scores, and work on one sound with an existing coach example and a short cue when available. Try the same sentence again and listen to your first and latest scored takes while the card stays open. Practice a short drill for the sounds you missed, then try a new sentence after the drill scores well. Scores describe individual recordings, not lasting progress. English pronunciation only; no translation, grammar correction or rewriting. No download, account or login needed. Your recording is sent to BoldVoice when you stop and is stored; see the privacy policy for retention and deletion.

defaultPrompt: Help me rehearse my interview answer aloud. Ask me for the text first.
Help me say my presentation opener more clearly. Ask me for the text first.
Give me a short sample sentence, listen to me read it, and score my pronunciation.
capabilities: Rehearse interview answers and presentation openers
Hear a coach sound example with a specific practice cue
Compare first and latest scored takes of the same text
Practice a targeted drill, then try a new sentence

positive.prompt: Help me practice my answer to 'tell me about yourself' out loud with BoldVoice: Thanks for having me. Over the last three years I have led a small team that rebuilt our checkout flow, and we cut failed payments by a third. I think this role is the natural next step.
positive.expected_behavior: The card opens showing the whole three-sentence answer and a record button; recording it returns an overall score, a color for every word and up to three words to work on.

positive.prompt: Check my pronunciation of this paragraph: Good morning, everyone. Today I want to show you how we cut our onboarding time in half, and what we learned along the way.
positive.expected_behavior: The card opens showing the paragraph as given and a record button.

positive.prompt: Use BoldVoice to practice saying: I'd like a coffee with oat milk.
positive.expected_behavior: The card opens showing "I'd like a coffee with oat milk." and a record button.

positive.prompt: I want to reduce my accent. Can BoldVoice help me practice?
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT opens the card so the user can practice a sentence and get scored, usually with a few words of guidance.

positive.description: Explain a result: send the prompt, record in the card, then tap Explain in ChatGPT under the result
positive.prompt: Use BoldVoice to practice saying: The weather is nice today.
positive.expected_behavior: Explain posts a message with the score and the card's ref; ChatGPT reads that result by ref and explains its score and focus words.

negative.prompt: Translate 'good morning, how are you?' into Spanish

negative.description: Grammar correction is out of scope
negative.prompt: Fix the grammar in this sentence: he go to school yesterday

negative.description: Rewriting text is out of scope
negative.prompt: Rewrite this sentence to sound more professional: we cut failed payments by a third

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.4. Adds an existing coach sound example and Sound Library cue for a supported focus sound; ephemeral first/latest same-sentence recording comparison; clearer targeted drill reasons and a new sentence after every drill word scores well; and more specific interview/presentation starters. Reloading, restarting or expiry clears local comparison audio. Existing recording storage and deletion rules remain in the privacy policy. The breakdown page describes the actual app-listing destination without promising a specific lesson handoff.
